purpose.zh: 练下背、臀部和大腿后侧，让你更有力地把身体抬起
purpose.en: Build your lower back, glutes, and the backs of your thighs for a stronger lift.

text.zh: 从髋部往下弯，背保持平直
text.en: Bend down from your hips and keep your back flat

text.zh: 垫子顶在髋骨下面，双手交叉放胸前。
text.en: Set the pad just below your hip bones and cross your arms on your chest.

text.zh: 抬到身体成一条直线就停，别再往后仰。
text.en: Stop when your body is straight, without leaning back further.

commonErrors.en: Swinging up and bending the lower back backward.
Rounding the back and dropping too fast.

cautions.zh: 腰不舒服时弯得浅一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back feels uncomfortable, bend less deep, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 主口令和起始口令去掉 hinge/「以髋为轴」，改「从髋部往下弯，背保持平直」
cue2 按动画补「双手交叉放胸前」，去掉「脊柱中立」；cue3 去掉动画里没有的「停一秒」（动画是在直线位停 1.3 s 后再下）
purpose 去掉「伸髋」；底部只停 0.5 s → rep_updown
flags: 动画一下从直线位开始往下（go=下放），口令顺序为 往下弯→到底→起到直线，请确认
